description:
Diversified Services Network, Inc. (DSN) is seeking a full-time Data Engineer – Snowflake & SQL to join our onsite team in Peoria, IL . We offer full benefits, PTO, 401k, and more! If you're looking to grow your career within an extremely reputable, stable Fortune 100 company - let's talk!
 Position Overview 
 In this onsite role (five days per week), you will design, build, and modernize governed enterprise data solutions as part of a small application development team. While the focus is the Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) data domain, you will also collaborate with teams across other data domains – gaining exposure to enterprise-scale data challenges and emerging AI-enabled solutions, and building relationships across IT and business functions.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Migrate and develop data structures in Snowflake and build and maintain warehouse and data-mart views.
 Design data models and transformations that deliver reliable, governed data for analytics, automation, and approved AI use cases.
 Validate data quality and troubleshoot data issues to root cause.
 Document data logic and lineage.
 Support Power BI reporting and system integrations.
 Manage code in GitHub using DevOps practices – source control, branching, pull requests, code review, and change management – to keep all development controlled, traceable, and auditable.
 Partner with EHS business partners, IT, data and analytics teams, and technical stakeholders to gather requirements, resolve data issues, and develop integrated enterprise solutions.
 Requirements 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related technical field and 4–6 years of professional experience  
 Advanced SQL skills, including query development, optimization, and troubleshooting.
 Strong Snowflake data engineering and data modeling expertise.
 Experience with enterprise data integration and governed warehouse/data-mart development.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail.
 Clear written and verbal communication skills.
 Ability to collaborate with technical and business partners and translate business requirements into technical data solutions.
 Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a cross-functional team.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Master’s degree.
 Qlik or similar integration experience.
 Experience with enterprise data governance, lineage, and metadata management.
 Experience working with EHS, regulated, or compliance-sensitive data.
 Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
 Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
 Continuous-learning mindset and adaptability to new technologies and processes.
 A track record of identifying opportunities for process improvement and data standardization.
 Benefits 
 401(k)
 Dental insurance
 Vision Insurance
 Disability insurance
 Employee assistance program
 Health insurance
 Health savings account
 Life insurance
 Paid time off
 Paid Holidays
 
 Please follow the link to our website for a list of job openings in Engineering, IT, Project Management, and more! https://www.dsnworldwide.com 
 
 Salary Expectations : $85,000-90,000 annually
